name: Clipboard history
oneLiner: a glass clipboard panel fills as copies land at the top one by one (text, a link, a screenshot), the count ticking, an accent selection walks down to one copy, Return is pressed and the copy lifts out as a pill, arcs across and drops into a white doc on the caret line under a wash of the brand colour
say: when the speaker says they copy things all day or paste something in ('I copy it, then just paste it into the doc', 'it keeps everything you copied'): the copies stack on 'copy', the paste lands on 'paste it in'
